answer: A river carries only so much jade. Each epoch, 36 sluices open on one river; a claimant dredges a jade token from the lagoon in one 25-minute window, seeded by the last block and the key, witnessed live by three strangers, at most two sluices each. Entry locks 85 POA, +40 per extra identity from one root: ten linked fakes lock 2,650 POA. One operator works two sluices at most, so ten fakes need five hands, ten dredges, thirty witnesses at once. A missed dredge burns 20; one token at two sluices burns both bonds. Dredge times match roots: ten sluices behind one hand collapse into one claim.
